home.heroTitle: Psychological events, groups and programs — online & across Europe
home.heroDescription: A curated catalog of verified psychological events for those seeking support, growth and change. Therapeutic groups, workshops, seminars, lectures, intensives, supervision and educational programs. Certified facilitators, transparent pricing, flexible formats: online from anywhere in the world, in-person in cities across Europe, or hybrid sessions. Filter by topic — anxiety, relationships, self-esteem, burnout, grief, self-discovery, professional development — compare programs and book your spot in 2 minutes.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text1: PsyGroup is a platform that helps people find safe and quality psychological events across Europe. We believe that group work, educational programs and therapeutic events are powerful tools for support and growth, available to everyone.
mission.text2: Our goal is to make the process of finding events simple, transparent, and safe. We connect people with verified organizers and create a community where everyone can find support, learning, or inspiration.

whatIs.title: What are psychological events and groups
whatIs.text1: Psychological events are various formats of work: from therapeutic groups to educational programs. A small group of people (usually 6-12) meets regularly under the guidance of a qualified specialist. Participants share experiences, support each other, and learn new ways to cope with life's challenges.
whatIs.text2: A therapeutic group creates a safe space where you can explore your experiences, receive feedback, and develop interpersonal skills. A support group helps you understand that you are not alone in your struggles.
whatIs.text3: Research shows that group therapy is effective for working with anxiety, depression, relationship issues, low self-esteem, burnout, and many other concerns. Educational programs, workshops, and seminars help develop professional skills and gain new knowledge.

verification.title: How We Verify Organizers
verification.text1: Participant safety is our priority. Each organizer undergoes verification before being listed on the platform:
verification.item1: Confirmation of qualifications and education in psychology or psychotherapy
verification.item2: Verification of professional experience and recommendations
verification.item3: Moderation of event descriptions and programs
verification.text2: We also respond to participant complaints and can remove organizers from the platform if they violate our standards.

forOrganizers.title: For Organizers
forOrganizers.text1: PsyGroup is a convenient tool for psychologists, therapists, and event organizers. We help you find participants and manage events:
forOrganizers.item1: Create and publish events with detailed descriptions
forOrganizers.item3: Manage schedules and communicate with participants
forOrganizers.text2: If you are a psychologist or organizer and want to list your events on the platform, contact us through the contacts page.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Here we've gathered answers to the most common questions about the PsyGroup platform, psychological events and groups.

items.q1: What are psychological events and groups and are they right for me?
items.a1: Psychological events are various formats of work: therapeutic groups, workshops, seminars, lectures, intensives, supervision, educational programs. A therapeutic group is a form of psychotherapy where a small group of people meets regularly under the guidance of a qualified therapist. It's suitable if you're seeking support, want to develop communication skills, or work on personal challenges in a group setting. Educational events are suitable for professional growth and gaining new knowledge.
items.q2: Do I need to register on the site to submit an application?
items.a2: No, registration is not required. You can submit an application to join an event without creating an account. Just fill out a short application form, and the organizer will contact you.
items.a3: Each organizer undergoes moderation before being listed on the platform. We verify qualifications, education, and experience in psychology or psychotherapy. We also moderate event descriptions and respond to participant complaints.
items.q4: How much does participation in an event cost?
items.a4: Each organizer sets their own participation cost. Prices vary depending on the format (online or offline), event duration, and facilitator qualifications. You'll see the current cost on each event's page.
items.q5: What if the event isn't right for me?
items.a5: If after the first meeting you realize the event isn't right for you, you can stop participating. We recommend discussing this with the organizer — they may suggest another event or format.
items.q6: Is the information I provide in my application confidential?
items.a6: Yes, all application data is confidential. We only share your application with the organizer of the event you applied to. We don't share data with third parties or use it for marketing.
items.q7: How can I become an event organizer on the platform?
items.a7: If you're a qualified psychologist or organizer and want to list your events on PsyGroup, contact us through the contacts page. We'll review your application and help you get started on the platform.
items.q8: What formats do meetings take place in?
items.a8: Meetings take place in three formats: online (via video conferencing), offline (in-person meetings in cities across Europe), and hybrid (a combination of online and offline formats). Choose the format that's most convenient for you.

dataCollection.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollection.text1: We collect the minimum data necessary for the platform to function:
dataCollection.item1: Email and name — for registration and communication
dataCollection.item2: Application data — name, email, answers to organizer questions
dataCollection.item3: Technical data — IP address, device type, cookies
dataCollection.item4: Information from organizers — qualifications, group descriptions

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.text1: Your data is used only for:
dataUsage.item2: Communicating with you about applications and groups

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.text1: We store your data on secure servers and use encryption for data transmission.
dataStorage.text2: Application data is stored for the time necessary to process the application and communicate with the organizer.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text1: We use cookies to save your session and language settings. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may limit platform functionality.

subject.title: Subject of Agreement
subject.text1: These terms govern the use of the PsyGroup platform. By using the platform, you agree to these terms.
subject.text2: PsyGroup is a platform for finding and publishing psychological events, group programs and meetings. We don't provide psychological services directly but connect participants with organizers.

registration.title: Registration and Account
registration.text1: Registration is not required to submit an event application. Organizers register with qualification verification.
registration.text2: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided and the security of your account.

organizers.title: Organizer Responsibilities
organizers.item1: Provide accurate information about qualifications and events
organizers.item2: Ensure safe and ethical meeting conduct

participants.title: Participant Responsibilities
participants.item2: Follow event rules set by the organizer
participants.item3: Respect the confidentiality of other participants

moderation.title: Content Moderation
moderation.text1: We moderate content on the platform and may remove events or profiles that violate our standards.
moderation.text2: If you believe content violates our rules, contact us through the contacts page.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.text1: PsyGroup is not responsible for the content of events or organizer actions. We provide a platform for connecting participants and organizers.
liability.text2: If you have issues with an organizer, contact us and we'll help resolve the situation.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.text1: We may change these terms. We'll notify you of significant changes on the platform. Continued use of the platform after changes means you agree to the new terms.
